Tilde.et: 19th century, from Spanish tilde, from Latin titulus. Doublet of Titel (“title”) and Tüttel (“dot”).

Till.et: Medieval diminutive of compound given names beginning with Diet- (such as Dieter or Dietrich), from Old High German thoit (“people”).

Tillmann.et: Combination of the given name Till and the ending -mann, in analogy with old names like Hermann and Hartmann.
